Subject: SIG questionnaire submission – next artifacts needed

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for walking through the SIG yesterday — we submitted the questionnaire this morning. Our security team ran a quick review and has a handful of required artifacts before we can move to legal review and procurement sign-off:

- SOC 2 report (most recent) — redacted copies acceptable
- Pen test summary or executive findings (we don’t need raw logs)
- ISO attestations or statements of applicability (if available)
- Updated security deck that covers architecture, encryption, and incident response

We tried to map some fields in the questionnaire to what you discussed, but there are a few gaps we flagged (I attached the filled questionnaire with comments). Can you confirm whether redacted SOC 2 + a pen test summary will suffice for initial approval? Also please confirm your standard retention period for access logs and whether logs are encrypted at rest.

We’d like to get this wrapped up this week if possible — can your team share artifacts by EOD Wednesday? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min handoff to walk through artifacts live.

Attachments: SIG_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx (with comments)

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Security Programs
CareBridge Health

Hi Hannah — attaching the initial set of artifacts for your review. Short notes below.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2027.pdf (redacted; control narratives preserved)
- PenTest_Summary_2027.pdf (executive summary only; full technical report is internal and available under NDA)
- Security_Overview_Deck.pptx (updated architecture, encryption, IAM, incident response)

Notes:
- SOC 2: We removed customer-identifiable data and vendor-specific IP in accordance with our redaction policy; the report includes the auditor statement and control testing period (2026–07 to 2027–06).
- Pen test: summary includes scope, severity buckets, and remediation status; we are not transmitting raw exploit data via email.
- ISO: we currently operate under ISO-aligned internal controls; we do not yet hold a full ISO 27001 certificate. We do have partner attestations for specific infrastructural components (we flagged these in the evidence mapping spreadsheet). Rishi will follow up with expected ETA on third-party ISO docs (estimated 8–10 business days).
- Logs: we retain access and audit logs for 365 days by default; logs are encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Incident response SLA: initial acknowledgement within 2 hours for sev-1 incidents, detailed action plan within 24 hours.

I’ll upload these files to the secure folder and send you the link now. If you need any additional redaction or a sanitized executive-only package, tell me and I’ll prepare it.

Secure share: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-carebridge-evidence

Marissa Cole

Marissa — thank you for the quick turnaround and the detailed notes. A few quick clarifications before the handoff:

1) Retention: can you confirm whether the 365-day retention is configurable per account or a global default? Our legal team may request a shorter retention for certain data classes.
2) Encryption: good to hear both at-rest and in-transit are covered — does that include backups?
3) Incident response SLA: do you provide a post-incident report and root-cause analysis to customers for sev-1 incidents?

We can take the meeting at Wed 11/3 14:00 PST if that slot is still available — would like Marissa and a product engineer on the call to walk architecture.

Best,
Hannah

Hannah — answers inline and next steps below.

1) Retention: our default is 365 days but retention is configurable at the customer account level for most log classes. We can document retention options in the evidence mapping spreadsheet and include steps to request a change (legal or support ticket).

2) Backups/encryption: backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and stored in a segregated, access-controlled bucket; in-transit encryption is applied to backup transfers as well.

3) Post-incident reporting: yes — for sev-1 incidents we provide a formal post-incident report with timeline, mitigation steps, and root-cause analysis within 14 calendar days (unless legal/regulatory needs require a redacted delivery).

Meeting: Wed 11/3 14:00 PST still works for us — calendar invite sent (30 min). I’ve also uploaded the artifacts to the secure folder and added an evidence mapping tab that ties files to SIG sections.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rooms/CBH-DEAL-8892 — procurement can trigger the DPA signature when ready.

If you want a brief executive-only packet (single PDF) for your board review, Marissa can assemble that after the meeting.

Thanks,
